title: ligusticum tenuifolium
intro: Ligusticum tenuifolium, commonly known as Mountain Fennel, is a perennial herb native to North America. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Fennel include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for respiratory issues and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Ligusticum tenuifolium include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
